profile.headline: Senior Software Quantum Engineer
profile.summary:
Software development engineer with 20+ years architecting high-performance systems across diverse technical domains—from hardware integration and computational geometry to distributed systems and AI/ML platforms, delivering scalable solutions impacting millions of users.

Technical foundation combines graduate-level training in Electrical Engineering with strong mathematical and physics background. Career spans building distributed systems in Java/Kotlin, designing domain-specific languages and compilers, optimizing high-performance algorithms in C++, and applying functional programming principles across implementations. Experience includes developing ML infrastructure for production environments, and more recently, building agent-based prototypes and analysis tools in Python using frameworks like strands-agents.

Throughout my career, technical work and leadership have been inseparable. Over 11 years leading R&D teams, setting technical direction, and coaching engineers through complex domain transitions. Experienced working across organizations with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Applied Scientists, and Business Leaders—aligning teams around shared technical visions and shipping research innovations to production.

Currently contributing to Kiro, an agentic AI-integrated IDE, working on the Science team to evaluate agent-based application architectures alongside applied scientists. This work has deepened my understanding of what makes agent systems effective in practice—from SDK ergonomics to runtime performance. It has also clarified that my passion lies in building software: applications that deliver value, platforms and tools that empower developers, the infrastructure that supports them, and prototypes that explore new possibilities.

Seeking opportunities to build production-grade agentic AI systems where deep systems thinking meets cutting-edge computational paradigms. Also exploring quantum computing as an area of intellectual curiosity.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE 3 AWS, Next Generation Developer Experience Science

Contributed to Kiro's General Availability (GA) on November 2025. More specifically, by working on:

• AI-Based Development Tools: Contributing to Kiro AI-integrated, spec-based IDE (vscode fork) project through scientific evaluations and optimizations of agent-based applications

• Research & Innovation: Collaborating with applied scientists on cutting-edge AI/ML research implementations for developer productivity tools
positions.insights: Skills: AI/ML System Development · Agent-based Applications · Scientific Evaluation & Metrics · Python

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE 3, Amazon Kids Backend Services

• Recommender/Search Systems Technical Leadership: Built and led the DICE team (4 engineers) interfacing with 4 teams (Catalog Metadata, Catalog Delivery, Recommendations/Machine Learning, Query Engine), defining priorities and deliverables. Reduced time-to-market for content rows from months to days, serving 10M+ customers.

• DSL Development & Implementation: Designed the Dynamic Item Composition Engine (DICE), a low-latency in-memory query engine, supporting the KidsQL domain-specific language, including its grammar, AST, IR, type system, and compiler in Kotlin.

• Advanced Search & ML: Prototyped hybrid search combining lexical/semantic approaches, achieving 4.76% improvement in qualified search rate with 20x latency reduction vs. Elastic/OpenSearch. The lexical, semantic and hybrid search capabilities were integrated as functions in the KidsQL language, making them available to the organization and customers through the DICE service.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE 2, Amazon Kids Backend Services

• Infrastructure Architecture: Designed and led Event Ingestion System (EIS) implementation using Kinesis streams and functional programming core in Java (Either monad)

• Quality Engineering: Created QualityBuildTools configuration package with static analysis tools, establishing best practices adopted across 400+ AWS and Devices & Services version sets
Team Leadership: Mentored engineers while scaling team from 3 to 8 engineers, eventually splitting into two teams

• Data Pipeline Design: Architected Amazon Kids Data Analytics Pipeline including data ingestion, predictive analytics, and exploratory analysis abstractions

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE 2 Amazon Transaction Risk Management System (TRMS) Feature Engineering

• ML Engineering Support: Abstracted data ingestion and ETL processes to accelerate ML scientist onboarding for new fraud detection variables and models

• Risk Systems Development: Implemented and maintained fraud detection variables in the Buyer Fraud Variable Computation Service

• Cross-Team Collaboration: Worked closely with ML scientists to streamline model development and deployment workflows

positions.title: Staff R&D Engineer
positions.locationName: Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile · On-site
positions.description:
Synopsys CATS® Mask Data Preparation, High Performance Computing, Computational Geometry and Combinatorial Optimization for semiconductor lithography

• Algorithm Innovation: Created two patented algorithms: polygonal sizing algorithm for continuous corner clipping (US20100194779, 2007) and notch detection/correction system for mask design data (US20150261909). Designed O(1) probabilistic algorithm for concurrent OASIS file processing, reducing processing time from hours to minutes for real-time workflows.

• Technical Leadership (2012-2015): Led Polygon Boolean Processor (PBP) research team developing novel C++11 algorithms for CATS core, including grid snapping and multi-boolean operations. Assembled, led, and mentored Advanced Geometry team conducting R&D for computational geometry problems.

• Performance Optimization: Achieved 10X scalability improvement for OASIS.MASK Direct Output flow (2010), average 4X TAT improvement for Manufacturing Rule Check flows (2014), and 2X TAT reduction for electron multi-beam Mask Exposure Tool (2013) through cache-coherent C++ implementations.

• Standards Leadership: Represented Synopsys in SEMI OASIS Working Group and OASIS.MASK task force, contributing four format enhancements and recognized as industry expert by customers and competitors.

• Strategic Impact: Contributed expertise in OASIS format and competitive solutions that influenced Intel's adoption of CATS for all OASIS.MASK flows (2012), displacing key competitor. Co-designed new OASIS library (2013) with team member, delivering excellent flexibility and quality as a key component across multiple projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Computational Geometry Algorithms · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Parallel Processing Architecture · Technical Standards Development · Source Control

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.locationName: Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile · On-site
positions.description:
• Telecommunications R&D: Designed and implemented value-added services for mobile communications companies using SS7 and Intelligent Network (IN) protocols

• Distributed Systems Design & Implementation: Developed scalable, fault-tolerant applications in C on Linux platforms with multi-threaded programming (pthreads), TCP/IP socket communication, and redundant hardware infrastructure

• Hardware Integration: Interfaced with Intel SS7 boards via C APIs and programmed GSM/GPRS modems with AT commands in Java, while building MySQL database interfaces

• Key Projects:
  • EOIN (2006): Designed socket interface and inter-node communication protocol for intelligent call routing system
  • Cell-ID LBS (2005): Implemented Chile's first Cell-ID Location Based Service, foundation for Zweiloc product line
  • USSD-Callback (2004): Built prepaid application for non-CAMEL networks

• Delivered production systems still in use as core components of Zweicom's product portfolio
positions.insights: Skills: Real-time Distributed Systems · Hardware API Integration · Multi-threaded Systems Programming · Telecommunications Protocol Design · Linux

positions.title: Faculty member, Electrical Engineering Department
positions.locationName: Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile · On-site
positions.description:
• Developed and taught the undergraduate Electronic Circuits EL42A class, enhancing curriculum with hands-on laboratory experiences.
• Mentored engineering students in circuit analysis and practical electronics, fostering their skills for future careers in Electronics.  
• Achieved high student satisfaction rates, contributing to the course's popularity and success within the Electrical Engineering Department.
• Inspired multiple students to pursue electronics careers through engaging pedagogy and practical problem-solving approaches, demonstrating ability to cultivate technical talent and passion for complex subjects.
positions.insights: Skills: Circuit Analysis and Design · Technical Mentoring · Laboratory Instruction · Knowledge Transfer
